actions.detail: Preflight and WorkPreflight froze DDL -> transaction API -> claim/receipt -> retry class -> DLQ audit under local P03-002/P03-003 projections.
Resolved payload purpose to a content-addressed Runtime Event reference and SHA-256 only. Outbox, receipt, and DLQ never duplicate prompt, response, reasoning, secret, PII, or business-truth bodies.
Added runtime outbox/receipt/DLQ tables, database identity and commit guards, transaction-owned repository APIs, bounded claims, retry classification, and immutable audit metadata.
Five real PostgreSQL integration tests passed on the first run: transaction rollback, duplicate receipt replay, bounded retry exhaustion, cross-tenant database rejection, and downgrade/rebuild.
Added exact P03-006 Verify, Security, Evidence, WorksetVerify, and RollbackVerify adapters without changing Catalog bytes.
The complete Agent CI suite passed with 195 unit/integration tests, 42 contract tests, and all format, lint, type, secret, clock, license, and dependency audit checks.
